**Evaluating datasheets and inventory**

I'm considering if unused datasheets are a problem. I realize I don’t need to use all of them. There's an issue with the inventory list from Boston that was misapplied. It looks like there are five items that might have data identity issues. I think it's necessary to fix the entity framing but also recognize I shouldn't include unnecessary padding. It seems unlikely that I'll need a longer list, so I'll focus on the relevant material.
